summary: The Food and Drug Administration has cleared the Twiist automated insulin delivery, or AID, system for use in adults with insulin-treated Type 2 diabetes. Sequel Med Tech, which sells the device, disclosed the 510(k) clearance on Friday. The FDA granted the clearance to Deka Research and Development, Sequel’s partner on Twiist. The FDA cleared Twiist after researchers linked the AID system to reduced blood sugar and increased time in the target glycemic range in a clinical trial.
